name: Yanagihori Takamine
source:
Yanagihori Takamine (1917 - 1975) was the principal of Heavenly Host Elementary School before its demolition. He seemed to be quite popular among the townsfolk in Tenjin for his charismatic personality, his work ethic and his firm but fair school policies.

[Edited from [url=http://corpseparty.wikia.com/wiki/Takamine_Yanagihori]Corpse party Wikia[/url]]
